style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 50cm Pre Lit Once Upon a Star Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Bring the wonder of winter to your home with this brilliant wreath. The 50cm Pre Lit Once Upon a Star Christmas Wreath gives you visual interest on your front door. Set it up and celebrate the season. The simple low-maintenance wreath provides ample faux foliage to get your season off the ground and keep your spirits up throughout those cosy winter evenings. There’s nothing quite like a wreath to get you in the festive mood. The cosy 40 LED lights create an uplifting ambience throughout the chilly winter. An optional 6-hour timer can automatically turn the lights on and then off again. There is also a constant ‘on’ mode. Make your Christmas special. Celebrate the time spent with family and friends, and make your home extra welcoming for a holiday season to remember with the 50cm Christmas wreath. Keep up your spirits during the winter and have the most magical holiday yet. The faux foliage wreath refreshes the mind and inspires the spirit with a gentle cosy aura. Dimensions (mm): Height: 500. Width: 500. Depth: 150.
